comment: Single source of truth for the agent tool surface. The core serves these to the sidecar, which keeps a compiled-in copy for when the core cannot be reached and serves them over MCP; scripts/generate-agent-tools.mjs emits the Rust method lists, and pnpm agent-tools:check proves every method still has a handler. Edit here, then run pnpm agent-tools:generate.

guide.name: guide
guide.description: Read before your first process or browser click. Pass a topic for one area in depth.
guide.comment: The sidecar answers it from the guide the core serves with this manifest, so it has no harness method.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Open a URL or go back, forward or reload, then wait for the page.

newTab.description: Open in a new tab; a tab of yours already on that site is used instead

hard.description: With go reload: skip the cache

waitFor.description: Condition to wait for after the load

tools.name: browser_state
tools.description: Read the tab: url, title, numbered elements, text, tabs, downloads.

tools.name: browser_find
tools.description: Find elements by visible text or accessible name.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element by number, text or selector, or a point.

index.description: Element number from state or find

text.description: Visible text or name, headings too

expectLabel.description: Refuse unless the target's label contains this

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type into a field, replacing its value, or at the caret.

index.description: Field number; omit to type at the caret

replace.description: Select the focused field's text first

tools.name: browser_press
tools.description: Press a key or chord, such as Enter or Meta+a.

tools.name: browser_act
tools.description: Run clicks, typing and keys in one call.

steps.description: Up to 20 click, type or press steps, with those tools' fields

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.description: Drag from one element or point to another.

tools.name: browser_upload
tools.description: Give files to a file input.

index.description: The file input, or the button opening a chooser

x.description: Point of that button, with y

tools.name: browser_dialog
tools.description: Answer the page's alert, confirm or prompt.

tools.name: browser_viewport
tools.description: Set this tab's viewport size or preset.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll to an element, by deltaY, or to an end.

index.description: Element to bring into view, or whose container deltaY and to scroll

text.description: Words of the element to scroll to

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Run a script in the page; returns JSON.

script.description: An expression, or statements ending in return; may await

tools.name: browser_network
tools.description: List the page's requests with status and body.

since.description: Only since the last page load

tools.name: browser_console
tools.description: List the page's console messages and errors.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the tab or the whole page.

index.description: Capture only this element; or text, role or selector

tools.name: browser_annotate
tools.description: Draw a labelled box or caption over the page.

index.description: Element to box; or x and y

tools.name: browser_record
tools.description: Record this tab to MP4, or stop recording.

tools.name: browser_wait
tools.description: Wait for text, a selector, a url or a quiet network.

urlGone.description: Until the URL no longer contains this

tools.name: browser_switch_tab
tools.description: Make one of this agent's tabs the current one.

tools.name: browser_close_tab
tools.description: Close one of this agent's tabs.

tools.name: sim_devices
tools.description: List the iOS simulators, the one you hold, and which other agents hold.

tools.name: sim_attach
tools.description: Attach a simulator by name or udid, else your project's own; boots it if needed and reads its screen.

tools.name: sim_state
tools.description: Read the attached simulator's screen: the frontmost app and numbered elements with their centre points.

tools.name: sim_tap
tools.description: Tap an element by number or label, or a point in device points. A duration makes it a long press.

tools.name: sim_swipe
tools.description: Swipe between two points in device points. Starting at a screen edge makes a system gesture.

tools.name: sim_type
tools.description: Type text into the focused field on the attached simulator.

tools.name: sim_button
tools.description: Press a hardware button on the attached simulator.

tools.name: sim_rotate
tools.description: Turn the attached simulator to an orientation and read its screen.

tools.name: sim_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the attached simulator's screen at its size in points.

tools.name: sim_launch
tools.description: Launch an installed app by bundle id, relaunching it if it runs, and read the screen.

tools.name: sim_terminate
tools.description: Quit an app on the attached simulator by bundle id.

tools.name: sim_install
tools.description: Install a built .app from inside the project on the attached simulator.

tools.name: sim_open_url
tools.description: Open a URL or deep link on the attached simulator.

tools.name: sim_touch_path
tools.description: Drag one finger through points over a duration, as a long-press drag or drawing.

tools.name: sim_touch2_path
tools.description: Move two fingers through points together, to pinch, spread or turn.

tools.name: sim_logs
tools.description: Read the attached simulator's log by cursor and generation, all of it or one process's.

tools.name: sim_detach
tools.description: Let go of the attached simulator, for another agent to use.

tools.name: workspace_inspect
tools.description: The open project: processes, runs and ports.

tools.name: process_start
tools.description: Start a sikemux.json process or shell command.

processId.description: From workspace_inspect or an earlier result

idempotencyKey.description: Yours, one per attempt; reuse it to retry

readyWhen.description: Output text meaning ready, e.g. Ready in

tools.name: process_restart
tools.description: Restart a process's latest run.

tools.name: process_read
tools.description: Read a process's output by cursor, tail or search.

cursor.description: Byte cursor: 0, then the one returned

tools.name: process_stop
tools.description: Stop a run and everything it started.

tools.name: ui_open
tools.description: Open a file, diff, terminal or the preview.

tools.name: page_preview
tools.description: Check a page as the chat shows it.

script.description: Runs in the page with its theme, as browser_evaluate does; its result comes back

tools.name: page_show
tools.description: Show a page in your reply.

tools.name: events_wait
tools.description: Wait for process or UI events, a file or a pid.

cursor.description: Event cursor from workspace_inspect or the last wait

file.description: Instead of a cursor: wait on this absolute path; with no text, until it stops changing

pid.description: Instead of a cursor: until this process exits

tools.name: agent_list
tools.description: List Sikemux agents.

tools.name: agent_send
tools.description: Message a Sikemux agent.

answers.description: Id of the question this answers

tools.name: agent_spawn
tools.description: Start a Sikemux agent.

cli.description: e.g. claude, codex; omit for a helper

provider.description: A connected model provider to pay for it

report.description: false: it does not report back

checkout.description: own: a git worktree of its own

host.description: Linked host to run it on

tools.name: who_wrote
tools.description: Who broke CI, a test or a commit, and how to reach them.

target.description: Commit, path or path:line, test name, CI run URL or id, or ci

tools.name: agent_sessions
tools.description: Search past agent sessions.

tools.name: agent_read
tools.description: Read what an agent said.

tools.name: agent_wait
tools.description: Wait until agents stop.

tools.name: agent_close
tools.description: Close agents.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask your lead or the person.

blocked.description: Default true: end your turn and wait

assumption.description: With blocked false: what you go on with

secret.description: The answer is a password or token

for.description: Agent whose question you pass on

tools.name: react
tools.description: React to the person's message with one emoji. Do it on most messages. Silent: never mention it.

tools.name: gif
tools.description: Send a GIF in your reply. Use it often, whenever one fits. Silent: never mention it.

query.description: Your own reaction back to them, not their words

tools.name: board_add
tools.description: Add a board card.

tools.name: board_list
tools.description: List the board.

tools.name: board_claim
tools.description: Claim a card.

tools.name: board_update
tools.description: Change a card.

parent.description: 0 takes it out from under one

tools.name: trigger_add
tools.description: Prompt this chat later.

title.description: What it is for, shown to the person

prompt.description: What this chat is sent when it fires

at.description: A time with its offset, once, such as 2026-10-28T09:30:00+05:30

daily.description: HH:MM on this host's clock, each day

board.description: Add a card to this project's board when it fires instead of prompting this chat

webhook.description: Fire on each request to an address it returns, instead of at a time

weekdays.description: With daily, the days it fires on; every day when left out

tools.name: trigger_list
tools.description: List your triggers.

tools.name: trigger_remove
tools.description: Stop a trigger.

tools.name: review_verdict
tools.description: Approve the change you are reviewing, or say what must change.

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Commit only the lines you wrote.

message.description: Omit to only land or push; no Co-Authored-By trailer naming yourself

paths.description: Files or folders, relative or absolute; default every line of yours

land.description: From a checkout of your own: put your commits on the branch it was cut from

push.description: Push your commits; only when the person asked

tools.name: skills
tools.description: Manage the skills every agent gets.

source.description: Folder path or git URL to install from

subfolder.description: The skill's folder in that repository

tools.name: app_console
tools.description: Read the Sikemux app's console and errors.
